evidence.title: GitHub - ilyichv/hookagain: A collection of shadcn installable react hooks

name: hookagain
summary: Collection of reusable React hooks installable with the shadcn CLI.
description: A collection of reusable React hooks that install like shadcn/ui components: add a hook with the shadcn CLI and use it in your project. The set covers clipboard, debounce, interval, local storage, media query, intersection observer and Phoenix channel/socket utilities.
contains: 9 React hooks, e.g. useCopyToClipboard, useDebouncedValue, useLocalStorage
also useMediaQuery, useIntersectionObserver, useInterval, usePhoenixChannel, usePhoenixSocket
installed with the shadcn CLI following the same principles as shadcn/ui
docs site with a page per hook
